Agglomerative clustering across cuts

The broad behaviour-level analysis: Ward agglomerative clustering on normalized MPNet embeddings, spanning all scenarios in each source. Browse every member at each saved hierarchy cut. No new embeddings or clustering were run for this page.

PETRI: all 801 qualifying summaries, every cut k = 2–800. WildChat eval: all 1,641 qualifying summaries, saved cuts k = 5, 10, 15, 20, 30, 40, 50. Sources are fitted separately. Verification ≥7; train/thinking and lower-scoring or unverified records are excluded.

Cuts are specified by cluster count k, not a cosine threshold. Silhouette is measured in the original embedding space. The PETRI peak is k=249 (0.204), with median size 3 and 44 singleton groups—higher score does not establish a broad behavioural taxonomy. Numeric IDs are local to each cut. Search filters displayed members without changing the saved assignments.
